verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://planetscale.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a PlanetScale summary. The docs also serve agent-oriented markdown, including _llms/postgres.md, _llms/api-reference.md, and .md versions of the agent and MCP pages, so an agent can be pointed at them directly. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice, and the /docs.md root index returns 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Interactive interface for running PostgreSQL queries and DDL against PlanetScale Postgres database branches.
The PlanetScale API allows you to manage your PlanetScale databases programmatically.
Connect an agent to PlanetScale to get help with your databases.
